title: Scaling Laws in Patchification: An Image Is Worth 50,176 Tokens And More
reviewed_version: PMLR volume 267 published original; retrieved exact supplied PDF URL
summary: Empirical trends survive the focused check. Learned information-loss mechanism and parameter convention need evidence; positional-transfer mismatch remains a supported Minor release defect.

problems.title: Information loss in the trained patch embeddings is unresolved
problems.evidence: A full-rank D>=3p^2 projection, including W=I for base p16,D768, is invertible. This defeats only a necessary-loss inference from token count, not the paper qualified often-loss claim about learned representations.
problems.counterevidence: Original p1 says often rather than always. Actual learned ranks/conditioning and sufficient-statistic properties are unknown; narrow embeddings can be dimension-reducing.
problems.impact: Mechanistic interpretation remains unresolved; no demonstrated losslessness of trained models or refutation of measured gains.
problems.acceptance_revision: Prior Minor label narrowed because an admissible invertible example does not falsify the source qualified empirical claim.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read original physical p1 qualified often statement; physical pp6-8 mechanistic interpretation and Table5; p12 Table7; static PatchEmbed lines32-55 and base configuration293-295.
independent_acceptance_check.hypotheses: Patch dimension3p^2, D768, p16 gives square projection. Bias can be zero and Conv2d kernel can implement flattened identity; identity normalization is actual constructor default. Such a map is within the layer class, but no checkpoint rank or conditioning was measured.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: A full-column-rank W has left inverse (W^T W)^-1W^T; patch rearrangement itself is bijective. 196*768=224*224*3=150528 shows no necessary scalar-dimension compression at base p16. This is an existence argument only.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Original says often, so the existence of W=I does not refute its claim about learned representations. Learned matrices can discard task-relevant information despite sufficient width; narrow models may have genuine bottlenecks. The previous Minor label treated an unproved learned-model inference as an established defect.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Narrowed to Needs Evidence; final TeX/findings synchronized and predecessor preserved. Retain the reversible construction as a scope clarification. Actual ranks/singular values/reconstruction and task-sufficiency evidence are needed; no trained-model-losslessness claim remains.

problems.title: Interpolation ablation does not identify information recovery as primary mechanism
problems.evidence: Token geometry, projection and access to spatial details remain different.
problems.counterevidence: Useful negative control for one sequence-extension method.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Actually viewed physical p8 Table5 and its following interpretation.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Interpolating fixed coarse tokens is deterministic postprocessing and adds no raw information. Its small gains versus re-embedding smaller patches compare multiple changes simultaneously: token geometry, parameterization, receptive fields and mixer access. The two arms do not isolate irreversibly lost information, even if the coarse embedding is invertible.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: It is a useful negative control for this specific sequence-extension intervention. The observed performance differences need not be false; the principal causal mechanism remains unidentified.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained; fixed/invertible projection and matched parameter/compute controls would address mechanism, but were not performed.

problems.title: Learned-position parameter delta differs from reported model-count descriptions
problems.counterevidence: Paper convention or historical implementation may differ.
problems.impact: Parameter accounting and causal comparison need paper-matched evidence.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read p12 Table7 D768/99M and p6 100M base reference; models_mamba.py185-194 learned positional parameter and32-46 patch convolution.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: At224 resolution parameters are (L+1)D for positions and (3p^2+1)D for biased projection. The freshly recomputed p1-minus-p16 total is37797120. Model size blocks otherwise fixed in the inspected base factories.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: The paper may count core blocks only or use another historical checkpoint/position scheme; neither is established. The report correctly treats this as a convention/version question instead of a proven table error.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained; require paper-matched parameter inventory and configuration before interpreting causal capacity equivalence.

problems.title: Resolution-transfer code treats end class token as a leading token
problems.evidence: Symbolic order p0,p1,p2,p3,CLS becomes preserved p0 plus interpolated p1,p2,p3,CLS.
problems.counterevidence: Unchanged resolution masks mismatch; historical execution unproven.

independent_acceptance_check.source_check: Read static models_mamba.py254-269 and main.py328-346; current code hashes agree with excerpts.
independent_acceptance_check.independent_derivation: Forward order is image tokens then CLS and adds pos_embed in that order. Transfer preserves first positional entry and interpolates the rest. For [p0,p1,p2,p3,CLS] it therefore interpolates [p1,p2,p3,CLS], mixing CLS into the image grid on a resolution change and failing to preserve final CLS position.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_dependency: Equal-size identity interpolation can leave the entire sequence effectively unchanged; different checkpoint conventions may differ. Historical use of this path and accuracy effects are unverified.
independent_acceptance_check.severity_and_repair: Minor release defect retained. For this tail-CLS convention retain the last entry and interpolate all preceding image entries; no end-to-end repair or historical rerun certified.

limitations: No author programs or checkpoints executed.
No exhaustive external reference, baseline or downstream code audit.
Historical implementation linkage, ranks and run-level metrics remain unavailable.
Other revisions and separate OpenReview attachments were not compared.
